title: Experimental Pocket application package build manifest
description: Container codec only. Does not certify Runtime integration, signature authenticity or physical hardware. The canonical loader also rejects duplicate JSON keys and non-integer numeric tokens.

runtime_api.description: The validator additionally requires min <= max; the loading Runtime API must lie in the inclusive range.

budgets.description: heap_bytes is the requested application-VM heap, NOT total UI RSS. asset_bytes includes every member byte, including source/catalog/notices. The whole container is independently capped at 16 MiB.

authentication.description: Unsigned containers require explicit opt-in. A digest does not authenticate a publisher.
